<!-- pr-reviewer: 28d06d2bceca23dadb3c8997c770635a2be13d97 -->
**Not built - needs a maintainer look.** No blockers found in the code. The dependency, script and workflow parts are read only, per the review rules, and the maintainer decides those.

**Build note:** main does not build (#844: `crates/motion/src/machining2d/trochoid_slot.rs`). Built and tested on PR + main + the pending #844 fix (PR #848, `4a5c9dd4ca304735f31ce9f936c4e66cecda0c26`). The main-only failure is not a finding against this PR.

**Merge state:** the trial merge with current main is textually clean. It also merges clean with PR #838 (checked with `git merge-tree`, not built).

### What looks good
- The shell split is a move. Compared `shell_window.rs` and `shell_window/frame.rs` against main's `shell.rs`: the differences are imports, `super::super::` paths, `pub(crate)` on `VIEW3D_FORMAT` and `Tab::title`, and reworded doc comments. Nothing is deleted; native-only items are cfg-gated in `egui_app/mod.rs`.
- `file_dialog.rs`: all 13 `rfd::FileDialog` sites (`state.rs`, `state_per_op.rs`, `state_setup_post_options.rs`, `state_tool_library.rs`) go through the seam. Native forwards unchanged. On wasm32 the pickers return `None` and print a stderr line naming #31, so cancel is explicit, not silent success.
- `clock.rs`: native is `std::time::Instant`. In `geometry/slice.rs` the clock is read only when projection profiling is on, so output is unchanged.
- On wasm32, `egui_app::run` refuses the windowed entry with a message and exit code 2 (`egui_app/mod.rs`), no panic.
- No `unwrap()`, `expect()` or `panic!` in the new non-test code (`file_dialog.rs`, `clock.rs`, `shell_window.rs`, `shell_window/frame.rs`).
- New modules carry provenance lines. No snapshot PNG changed. No process file changed, so no `PROCESS_VERSION` bump is due.
- `Cargo.lock` gains one line (`web-time` under camcraft-app). No new package enters the lock.
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: comment-only edit. Triggers are still `workflow_dispatch` only (lines 12-13); no `push`, `pull_request` or `schedule`.
- PR body: what changed, how it was tested, a "Not exercised" section that says the wasm UI has never run in a browser, deps and scripts listed, a `Changelog:` line, `Refs #31` (not `Fixes`).

### Local results (this review's tree: PR + main + #848)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Trial merge with origin/main | clean (textual) |
| origin/main alone, `camcraft-motion` lib | fails: 7 errors E0308/E0609 in `trochoid_slot.rs` lines 233, 238, 239, 241, 249, 255 (#844) |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib --no-run` | builds |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` (cwd `crates/ui`) | 481 passed, 0 failed, 5 ignored |
| `file_dialog::tests::file_dialog_builder_keeps_every_setting` | ok |
| `clock::tests::clock_seam_is_monotonic_and_does_duration_math` (camcraft-app) | **not run**: the app test build recompiled the dev-dependency tree past the time box; stopped |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | **not run** (same reason) |
| `web/build-app-wasm.sh`, any wasm32 build | **not run** (by rule: needs a maintainer look) |

### Requested before merge
None blocking from the code read. Before merging, the maintainer should run the two items this review did not finish: clippy `-D warnings` on camcraft-app and camcraft-ui, and the clock test by name.

### Questions and notes (not blocking)
1. Dependencies: `web-time` is wasm32-only in `crates/app/Cargo.toml`; `egui-winit` and `rfd` are native-only in `crates/ui/Cargo.toml`. Native builds keep them. Confirm you accept this target-gating.
2. `web/build-app-wasm.sh` step 4 builds `--bin camcraft-ui` (the bin exists, `crates/ui/Cargo.toml` lines 44-46). It adds no download or install; it uses the same flecs patch as step 1. Not run here.
3. Size: `shell.rs` is 925 lines (down from 1676), so this is an acceptable step; the viewport split is the next seam. `shell_window/frame.rs` is a new file at 409 lines, 9 over the ~400 law. Not blocking, but a small split now or a follow-up issue would keep the rule clean.
4. `gpu.rs` still uses `pollster::block_on` and is not cfg-gated. The body lists that as owed, so it is fine for this rung.
5. Overlap: #838 merges clean with this branch by tree check. #847 is stacked on this branch; this review does not undo draft, so #847 is unaffected.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
